confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Kathmandu tourist-district pricing (Thamel and similar areas); no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and hostel dorm anchors are moderately certain. Private hostel and 3-star hotel rates vary widely by season and location and are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass are derived from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weak. The FX observation came from an RBA-linked search result snippet for 15 October 2026 (4.00 pm) and was not read in full.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Nepal's tourist hubs (Thamel and Pokhara), cross-checked against backpacker price levels in northern India and budget Southeast Asian capitals. Price levels were benchmarked to general knowledge of local NPR pricing, not to current listings.
